html: I. כור (√ of foll.; perhaps be or make round, hence furnace, pot, basin, from shape; Arabic كَارَ wind about (e.g. a turban), كَوْرٌ turn or twist (of turban), كُورٌ blacksmith’s fire-place, hornets’ or bees’ nest, كَارَةٌ bundle; كُور means also a camel’s saddle (or ‘howdah’) with its apparatus, v. Frey Lane. > Thes comp. Syriac ܐܶܬܟܰܘܰܪ incaluit (Lexx. aestuavit, calefactus est)).
